name: Knockout Artist (Combat)
body:
You have a real knack for rendering foes unconscious.

Prerequisite(s): Sneak attack 2d6, Heal 1 rank.

Benefit: Whenever you deal sneak attack damage to an unaware target or during a surprise round you may choose to deal nonlethal damage. If you do, that target must make a Fortitude save with a DC equal to 10 + the number of sneak attack dice you possess + your Intelligence modifier or be knocked unconscious for 1 minute. Any further damage will wake the enemy, and an adjacent creature can spend a full round action to wake them. If there were no witnesses to this attack and your target failed its Fortitude save, the attack is not considered to have broken your stealth.
